name: GetYourRefund Free Tax Filing
description: A free, IRS-certified virtual tax filing service for low-income households across America, with options to file on your own with help (FileMyself), have a tax expert file for you over the internet (Assist, Virtual), or find a local IRS site to file in person. Completely free. The service was closed for the season when checked and says it reopens late January.

requirements.text: Available to residents of all states (and Puerto Rico and non-residents, with limits).
FileMyself: income must be under $89,000. Assist (Virtual or In-person): suggested income under $69,000.
Not open right now: the site says it will notify you as soon as the service reopens late January.

unknowns: The tax year the income limits apply to is not stated.
The exact reopening date is not stated beyond late January.
Documents needed are not listed on the page.
In-person locations near Amherst are not listed on the page.
program_period: Reopens late January (closed when checked on 2026-11-14)

first_step.title: Sign up for free virtual tax help
first_step.detail: Go to GetYourRefund and sign up to be notified when it reopens in late January. Then choose FileMyself or have a tax expert file for you.
